definitions.gloss: withheld number; caller ID blocked; anonymous call
definitions.explanation: A phone call whose caller number is deliberately hidden, so the phone shows "{非通知|ひつうち}" instead of a number. Also the setting that withholds one's own number when calling.

examples.japanese: {非通知|ひつうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I don't answer calls from withheld numbers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{非通知|ひつうち}にして⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To make a call with the number withheld.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧{非通知|ひつうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}→着信：07685_chakushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{気味|きみ}→気味：13448_kimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: I kept getting anonymous withheld calls, which was creepy.

notes:
A call whose number is hidden, or the setting that hides one's own number. Displayed on the phone as {非通知|ひつうち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非通知|ひつうち}⟦{着信|ちゃくしん}→着信：07685_chakushin⟧: an incoming call with the number withheld
- {非通知|ひつうち}でかける: to call with one's number hidden
- {非通知|ひつうち}⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧: caller-ID-block setting
